map.审查别人写的长查询：格式化后看清字段层级与参数，便于指出多余字段或潜在的 N+1: Review a long query written by someone else: formatting lays out the field hierarchy and arguments so redundant fields or potential N+1 risks stand out.
map.纯格式化不校验，需配合校验器。: Formatting alone does not validate; pair it with a validator.
map.格式化会改变查询语义吗？: Does formatting change the query semantics?
map.不会。GraphQL 忽略空白与逗号，格式化只调整缩进与换行，查询结构与变量定义: No. GraphQL ignores whitespace and commas, so formatting only adjusts indentation and line breaks while the query structure and variable definitions stay exactly the same. Comments, however, are written with # and some minifiers strip them — if a comment carries important information (a @deprecated note, say), confirm what the tool does before running it.
